standards.title: RBI IT governance
standards.applicability_trigger: India; in-scope regulated entity or contractual flow-down
standards.required_evidence: Governance, change, risk, continuity, audit; entity-specific clause extraction required

standards.title: RBI IT outsourcing
standards.applicability_trigger: India; regulated customer outsourcing IT services
standards.required_evidence: Outsourcing due diligence, contracts, access/audit, exit and subcontractors

standards.title: RBI payment security and payment-data storage
standards.applicability_trigger: India; payment operator/participant, service and data scope
standards.required_evidence: Resolve digital-payment security, cyber resilience and storage location obligations per actor

standards.title: RBI KYC and fraud directions
standards.required_evidence: Obtain current KYC/fraud directions, entity applicability, retention and reporting authority

standards.title: NPCI UPI rules and certification
standards.version_pin: Customer/scheme release and circular bundle required
standards.applicability_trigger: UPI participant or contracted technology service in participant scope
standards.required_evidence: Authorized current rules, certification, disputes, limits and participant obligations; overview is insufficient

standards.title: DPDP Act and Rules
standards.version_pin: Act2023; Rules14Nov2025; corrigendum16Dec2025; per-provision commencement pending
standards.applicability_trigger: Digital personal data processing within applicable statutory scope
standards.required_evidence: Pin Gazette, corrigendum and phased enforcement per clause before claiming current obligations

standards.title: CERT-In directions
standards.applicability_trigger: India; covered entity and service categories
standards.required_evidence: Determine incident clocks, log/clock and service-specific requirements from operative directions

standards.title: IT Act and applicable evidence law
standards.applicability_trigger: India; electronic records, access, digital signatures and disputes
standards.required_evidence: Resolve electronic evidence, offences, record admissibility and signatures; no generic compliance declaration

standards.title: PMLA rules and FIU-IND
standards.applicability_trigger: Reporting entity/customer financial-crime service and applicable digital-asset activities
standards.required_evidence: Pin reporting-entity duties, schema, retention, confidentiality and accountable filer

standards.title: TRAI commercial communications
standards.applicability_trigger: India outbound marketing, voice/SMS and relevant sender/operator role
standards.required_evidence: Determine consent, preferences, registration, recording/disclosure and channel requirements

standards.title: UIDAI and CKYCR/CERSAI
standards.applicability_trigger: Aadhaar or CKYCR integration and KYC tokenization
standards.required_evidence: Obtain authorized UIDAI and CERSAI interface/legal profiles separately; no assumed access entitlement

standards.title: Sector and corporate obligations
standards.applicability_trigger: Actual entity, products, staff, assets and customer sector
standards.required_evidence: Separate triggered instruments into versioned child records before affected operations

standards.title: RBI FREE-AI
standards.version_pin: Report and subsequent directions pending verification
standards.required_evidence: Distinguish report recommendations from subsequent enforceable directions

standards.title: ISO/IEC 27001

standards.title: ISO/IEC 27701
standards.required_evidence: Privacy management system; map actual processing roles and licensed requirements

standards.title: ISO/IEC 42001
standards.required_evidence: AI scope, impact/risk, accountable oversight and lifecycle evidence

standards.title: ISO/IEC 27017
standards.required_evidence: Cloud control responsibilities and shared-responsibility evidence

standards.title: ISO/IEC 27018
standards.required_evidence: PII protection and provider processing controls

standards.title: ISO/IEC 23894
standards.required_evidence: AI risk identification, treatment and monitoring

standards.title: ISO/IEC 25010
standards.applicability_trigger: Product quality model and acceptance profile
standards.required_evidence: Quality attributes translated into measurable acceptance criteria

standards.title: ISO/IEC 20000-1
standards.required_evidence: Service lifecycle, SLA, changes, incidents and suppliers

standards.title: ISO 22301
standards.required_evidence: BIA, continuity strategies and exercised recovery

standards.title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207
standards.required_evidence: Lifecycle process, deliverables, review and traceability

standards.title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119 series
standards.version_pin: Each selected part and edition pending pin
standards.required_evidence: Testing process, documentation, techniques and specific applicable parts

standards.title: ISO 9001
standards.required_evidence: Quality objectives, processes, corrective action and management review

standards.title: ISO 20022 repository
standards.version_pin: Per-message ID/version, XSD, code-set and snapshot hashes required
standards.applicability_trigger: Financial message product and relevant communities
standards.required_evidence: Data dictionary/business process catalogue; pin message and usage profile, semantic/state test suite

standards.title: ISO 20022 usage profiles
standards.version_pin: Customer/scheme profile and exact release pending
standards.required_evidence: Repository standard is distinct from a participant's usage rules and interoperability acceptance

standards.title: SWIFT CSCF
standards.applicability_trigger: SWIFT user architecture type and in-scope components

standards.version_pin: v2026 curriculum identifies policy/IAF; operative package required
standards.required_evidence: Licensed/current policy and assessor eligibility; multi-LLM review cannot replace independent assessment

standards.title: SWIFT CBPR+ / FIN / connectivity

standards.applicability_trigger: SWIFT messaging or partner solution in selected service scope

standards.title: NIST CSF
standards.required_evidence: Organization current/target profiles and measured outcomes

standards.title: NIST AI RMF
standards.required_evidence: Map intended use, risks, measurement and management; select GenAI profile separately

standards.title: NIST SSDF
standards.required_evidence: Secure development practices and evidence; do not treat draft successor as final by default

standards.title: NIST AI secure development profile
standards.required_evidence: Secure AI/model development profile; dataset/model pipeline evidence

standards.title: NIST SP800-53
standards.required_evidence: Tailor selected controls/parameters and independent assessment; crosswalk is not equivalence

standards.title: NIST zero trust
standards.required_evidence: Continuous contextual authorization and resource boundaries

standards.title: NIST incident response
standards.required_evidence: Incident preparation, response, recovery and improvement

standards.title: NIST identity crypto privacy supply-chain extensions
standards.version_pin: SP800-63, SP800-57, SP800-161, Privacy Framework: exact editions pending

standards.title: OWASP ASVS
standards.applicability_trigger: Web/API application verification; select risk-based profile/level
standards.required_evidence: Version-qualified requirement IDs and test evidence; level selected by actual risk and contract

standards.title: OWASP Web Top10
standards.required_evidence: Awareness taxonomy supports threat coverage; passing Top10 list is not full security verification

standards.title: OWASP API Security Top10
standards.required_evidence: Object/property/function authorization and API-specific abuse coverage

standards.title: OWASP MASVS and MASTG
standards.required_evidence: Pin separate verification and testing guides; platform-specific manual tests

standards.title: OWASP SAMM WSTG and Cheat Sheets
standards.applicability_trigger: Security maturity, testing and implementation guidance
standards.required_evidence: Separate maturity measurement from specific test procedures and code guidance

standards.title: OWASP GenAI and agentic security
standards.version_pin: Exact LLM/agentic release documents and commits pending
standards.applicability_trigger: LLM applications, RAG, tools and agent systems
standards.required_evidence: Threat-model prompt injection, excessive agency, memory/tool attacks and unsafe outputs

standards.title: PCI DSS and associated card standards
standards.version_pin: DSS exact current package and related PIN/P2PE/3DS profiles pending
standards.applicability_trigger: Cardholder/sensitive authentication data or in-scope service provider

standards.title: FATF Recommendations
standards.applicability_trigger: AML/CFT and virtual-asset risk design subject to domestic law

standards.title: WCAG
standards.version_pin: 2.2; exact dated W3C recommendation snapshot pending
standards.applicability_trigger: Web/UI/accessibility profile; organization targets AA subject to actual legal/contract profile
standards.required_evidence: Success-criterion matrix, keyboard/assistive-technology manual evidence and exceptions

standards.required_evidence: Determine exact applicable legal/technical instruments; WCAG target alone does not establish legal compliance
